description: This file defines interfaces and structures for implementing incremental glyph loading in the FreeType font rendering library. It includes type definitions, function prototypes, and documentation for client-implemented functions to load glyph data and metrics incrementally.

methods.name: FT_Incremental_GetGlyphDataFunc
methods.description: Function to access glyph data bytes during glyph loading, returning an error code.

methods.name: FT_Incremental_FreeGlyphDataFunc
methods.description: Function to release glyph data bytes obtained from GetGlyphDataFunc.

methods.name: FT_Incremental_GetGlyphMetricsFunc
methods.description: Function to retrieve glyph metrics before accessing glyph data.
